title: Jad global.json (workspace layout)
description: The global setting of the workspace layout (docs/design_workspace_layout.md), G/global.json, where G is $HOME/.jad unless JAD_GLOBAL_DIR names another folder. It is read only when the server starts in a directory that has .jad/workspace.json and no root setting is named; a start without workspace.json never reads it and uses setting.json as before. Read once at start. Relative paths are relative to G. An unknown key is refused.

workspaces.description: The other workspaces this server serves besides the one it starts in. A workspace is one exact directory with .jad/workspace.json. A listed workspace that is missing or whose workspace.json is broken is skipped with a warning. Two entries with the same id or directory, a relative path, and a workspace that is G's parent (or holds G, such as $HOME) are refused. A start directory that is not listed takes its folder name as id.

id.description: The workspace id, used in session references as <id>:<session>.

path.description: The workspace directory: absolute or starting with ~.

catalogs.description: Folders of the shared catalogs, relative to G. Defaults: models, tools, mcp, remotes, sandbox. Profiles, sessions and state belong to each workspace (W/.jad/profiles, W/.jad/sessions, W/.jad/state); a workspace's private models and tools are W/.jad/models and W/.jad/tools, and a name found in both the global and the workspace folder is an error naming both files.

sandbox.description: As catalogs.sandbox of root-setting.schema.json, relative to G.

defaults.description: Setting values every session of every workspace starts from, below the workspace's defaults. A relative env_file or cwd here is relative to G. In the workspace layout a profile may tighten, never loosen, the caps (max_run_tokens, max_run_cost_usd, max_run_duration_ms, budget caps) and an enabled sandbox these defaults set.

libraries.description: The global content library, shared by every workspace: folders relative to this file's folder (G), read once at start. A kind not set uses the built-in default folder under G (.agent/prompts, .agent/templates, .agent/skills, .agent/commands). A skill or command name also found in a workspace's own library is left out and naming it is an error (docs/design_workspace_layout.md Q3).
